claims.text: The selected sharing layer is trained using a sifted multi-task learning method that employs a gate mechanism and attention mechanism to filter and select shared features between tasks.
The training involves a global loss function that minimizes the cross-entropy of predictions across tasks, with specific weights assigned to each task.
The model incorporates a transformer encoder module to enhance the encoding of input representations for both tasks, improving performance by capturing long-range dependencies.
